article.title: NFL EDGE Saturday Evening Brief
article.dek: Arizona's quarterback is settled, Detroit moved a full point, and the Value card is empty tonight.

items.headline: Arizona's quarterback is settled: Josh Johnson starts
paragraphs: Carson Beck is out. The Cardinals downgraded him on Saturday because of back spasms, and Josh Johnson will start Sunday at Kansas City at 1:00 p.m. ET.
That makes Johnson Arizona's fourth starting quarterback in four weeks. Rookie Joey Aguilar is the backup. Both men signed with the team just last week.

The app has caught up. It now lists Johnson as Arizona's expected starter, so the numbers for this game reflect the change. The app has Kansas City winning by about 6, not 16.5, and it still put no card on this game.
items.takeaway: Beck is out and Josh Johnson starts at Kansas City. The app has updated, and it still has no card on this game.

items.headline: Mayfield is expected to play, but it is not final yet
paragraphs: Baker Mayfield is expected to start Sunday at Detroit, barring a setback. That is the word from Tom Pelissero of The Ringer, and every sign points the same way.

Here is what he is playing through. Mayfield has a plantar fascia injury in his foot, and he is expected to wear a special orthotic and new cleats to manage it. He is officially questionable. He sat out Wednesday and practiced on a limited basis Thursday and Friday.

If he cannot go, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels would start. It is not final until the inactives come out, about 90 minutes before the 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff. The app lists Mayfield as Tampa Bay's expected starter.
items.takeaway: Mayfield is expected to play through a plantar fascia injury, but the inactives settle it about 90 minutes before kickoff.

items.headline: Weather: same rain, same wind as this morning
paragraphs: Rain is likely at kickoff in Chicago, Philadelphia, and at MetLife for Jaguars at Giants. Chicago gets 57 degrees with wind at 15 mph gusting to 25. Philadelphia gets 62 degrees and a good chance of rain for the 4:25 p.m. ET kickoff. MetLife gets 63 degrees and rain for the 4:25 p.m. ET kickoff.
Kansas City stays dry but windy: 49 degrees, wind at 15 mph gusting to 24. Carolina gets a light rain chance, and Buffalo is clear at about 66 degrees.
That is the weather, plain and simple. It is not a totals edge, and it does not change what the app says. Note it, then bet the numbers.
items.takeaway: Rain likely in Chicago, Philadelphia, and at MetLife. Wind about 15 mph in Chicago and Kansas City. Mild everywhere else.

sections.title: What It Means for NFL EDGE

items.headline: How to read tonight's two cards
paragraphs: There are two cards tonight, not three. Hit Rate is Jaguars moneyline at -255 on FanDuel, the most likely winner on the board. The app gives Jacksonville about a 76 percent chance, against about 72 percent needed to break even. A -255 price means every $2.55 you risk wins $1.

Balanced is Jets +3 at -104 on FanDuel, about a coin flip and the middle ground — a strong pick without paying too much. The app gives the Jets about a 51 percent chance, against about 51 percent needed.

Value is empty tonight. The Giants +6 at -110 that was the Value pick this morning is not on a card this evening. That is not a bet against the Giants. It is the app saying nothing cleared the bar for that lane tonight. When a lane is empty, there is no card to chase. If you like the Giants at your book anyway, type the line and the price into Check and let the app run it back through the model and the evaluator.
items.takeaway: Hit Rate is Jaguars moneyline -255, the most likely winner. Balanced is Jets +3 at -104, about a coin flip. Value has no card tonight.

items.headline: The app still thinks the big spreads are too fat, and it still bet none of them
paragraphs: Look at the gaps. The app has Kansas City winning by about 6, not 16.5. Buffalo by about 3.4, not 16.5. Chicago by about 0.2, not 11.5. Detroit by about 1.7, not 5.5.

Those are big disagreements with the market, and the app put none of those dogs on a card. A gap is a starting point, not a bet. The card is what the model and the evaluator agreed on after the full check.

If one of those dogs catches your eye at your book, do not just take it. Type the line and the price into Check and let the app run it back through the model and the evaluator. That is what Check is for.
items.takeaway: Big spreads, big model gaps, zero cards on the dogs. The gap alone is not the bet. Check your price.

items.headline: Key numbers: 3 and 7 decide more games than any others
paragraphs: In football, most games are decided by 3 or 7 points. That is because of how scoring works: a field goal is worth 3, and a touchdown with the extra point is worth 7. So final margins land on 3 and 7 far more often than on 4, 5, or 6.

Here is a clearly labeled hypothetical example. Imagine a favorite listed at -3. If that team wins by exactly 3, a bet on the favorite pushes — your stake comes back, no win, no loss. If the line were -2.5 instead, that same 3-point win cashes. If the line were -3.5, that same 3-point win loses. The half point on either side of 3 is called the hook, and it is the most expensive half point in football.
That is why a line moving from -3 to -2.5, or from +3.5 to +3, matters more than most half-point moves. The number itself is the story, not the team.
items.takeaway: Games land on 3 and 7 more than any other margin, so the half point on either side of 3 — the hook — is worth more than most half points.

items.headline: Detroit moved a full point toward Tampa Bay
paragraphs: Detroit went from -5.5 this morning to -4.5 this evening on DraftKings and FanDuel. That is a full point toward the dog, and it is the one real move of the day.

The news behind it is no secret. Detroit lost Aidan Hutchinson for the season to a torn ACL, and Tampa Bay's Baker Mayfield is now expected to play through his foot injury. The market moved toward the app's number — the app has Detroit winning by about 1.7, not 5.5.

If your book still shows Tampa Bay at +5.5, Check it now. That number is gone from the board. If it shows +4.5, Check that too, and let the app run it back through the model and the evaluator on your price.
items.takeaway: Detroit moved a full point to -4.5 after the Hutchinson news and the Mayfield update. The +5.5 is gone from the board.

items.headline: Everything else held — and the Value card went quiet
paragraphs: The rest of the card barely moved. The Jaguars moneyline went from -253 to -255 on FanDuel, a touch more expensive for the same pick. The Jets are still +3 at -105 on DraftKings. Dallas is still -7.5. The Jets at Chargers total is still 42.5 on DraftKings.

The change is the Value card. The Giants +6 at -110 is still on the DraftKings board at the same line and price as this morning, but the app put no Value card out this evening. No offer cleared the bar for that lane.

Read that for what it is. It is not the app turning on the Giants. It is the app putting out two cards instead of three because the third one did not earn its place. If your book has a Giants price you like, Check it — the app will give you a bet or no-bet verdict on your price.
items.takeaway: Jaguars moneyline got a touch more expensive, everything else held, and the Value lane is empty tonight even though Giants +6 is still on the board.

items.headline: Sunday morning, check twice
paragraphs: Two things settle before kickoff. Mayfield's foot gets its final answer with the inactives, about 90 minutes before the 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff. Arizona's quarterback is already settled, so there is nothing to wait on there — Johnson starts.

The board refreshes every morning and evening, so the numbers you see tonight are not the numbers you will see tomorrow morning. Check your prices tonight while it is quiet, then check them again Sunday morning after the refresh.

And if your book has a good number right now and Check says bet, bet now. Detroit's +5.5 vanished during the day while people waited. A good number today beats a hoped-for number on Sunday, because waiting lets the number drift the wrong way too.
One more thing, and it matters. Settlement is manual — the tracker only works if you are honest with yourself. Log the losers too.
items.takeaway: Check tonight, check again Sunday morning after the refresh, and if Check says bet on a good number now, take it — Detroit's +5.5 is already gone.
